resolvedMediumFindings.finding: Break timestamp earlier than its known target execution
resolvedMediumFindings.syntheticReproduction: Native T at relative time 100, quantity 100, followed by B at relative time 50 for the same scoped identity, price, and quantity.
resolvedMediumFindings.resolution: Reject the break when its timestamp precedes the known target, before break identity registration or share-conservation mutation.
resolvedMediumFindings.observedAfterRepair: Both L and T target variants reject. Exact equal timestamps remain valid.

resolvedMediumFindings.finding: First-observed original execution after an unmatched native break
resolvedMediumFindings.syntheticReproduction: Unmatched native B at relative time 100 followed by a later native sequence containing first-observed T at relative time 50 for the same scoped identity, price, and quantity.
resolvedMediumFindings.resolution: Reject a first-seen execution after a retained unmatched B in the identical native identity scope, before book, signature, or quantity mutation. Native B refers to a previously sent L/T; the adapter does not create a second pending-correction resolver.
resolvedMediumFindings.observedAfterRepair: Both L and T variants reject, including a filtered prior break. An exact duplicate of an already-known original after its break remains an idempotent no-op.
